title: Enquirer’s Guide: Is it dangerous?
summary: An opening can drift, a route can change, and strong sonance can gradually alter exposed objects.
author: The Enquirer’s Guide Desk
paragraphs: This entry from The Enquirer’s Guide answers a question often put to the Society: “Is it dangerous?”
An opening can drift, a route can change, and strong sonance can gradually alter exposed objects.
Expeditions compare clocks, keep departure registers, and watch forecasts of layer weather. These precautions reduce uncertainty; they do not turn every crossing into a safe journey.

Readers should treat the answer as an introduction rather than a final authority. Eidetic science in Alderwick is reported through measurements, disputed interpretations and careful revisions, and a respectable enquiry may properly end with further questions.
